description: List XRPL Payment Channels owned by the account. By default, returns channels where the account is the source. Use destination_account to filter to channels whose destination is a specific account. Use to inspect channels before or after PaymentChannelCreate/Fund/Claim.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose Payment Channels should be listed.
account.title: Account

destination_account.description: Optional destination account filter. When supplied, return channels whose destination is this account.
destination_account.title: Destination Account

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Maximum number of Payment Channel entries to return. Default is 200.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_channels
